title: Update Complete!
setup: The fridge upstairs chimes. The update finished. Everything inside has spoiled.

options.label: Eat the least spoiled can
options.outcome: Two rations of something. {name} regrets it by evening.

options.label: Leave it all up there
options.outcome: The fridge plays a little song of thanks.

title: Good Boy, Again
setup: The retriever is back at dawn, dragging a medkit by its strap.

options.label: Take it and let him in
options.outcome: He stays. The medkit has only been chewed a little.

options.label: Take it and send him off
options.outcome: He leaves. Nobody says anything for a while.

title: Fleas
setup: Everyone is scratching. The dog looks innocent, which is suspicious.

options.label: Spray everything
options.outcome: The shelter smells like a summer evening. The fleas disagree, briefly.

options.label: Scratch and bear it
options.outcome: Three itchy days. Everyone's temper shortens.

options.label: Wash everyone in drinking water
options.outcome: Clean people, clean dog, a lot less water.

title: A Note Under the Hatch
setup: A bag hangs from the hatch handle. Inside: water, and a crayon drawing of your hatch.

options.label: Take it inside
options.outcome: The drawing goes up by the radio. The water goes on the shelf.

options.label: Leave the water for someone else
options.outcome: You keep the drawing. Someone else gets the water.

title: Paid Back
setup: The teenager is back with a friend and a sack. "For the water," they say.

options.label: Take the sack
options.outcome: A can and a bottle. They're gone before anyone can say thanks.

options.label: Invite them to eat
options.outcome: The shelter is loud for an hour. It's a good loud.
